package examplerelation

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"regexp"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

var (
	relationSlugPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`)
	supportedRelations  = map[string]struct{}{
		domain.LessonRelationImplementation: {},
		domain.LessonRelationPractice:       {},
		domain.LessonRelationComparison:     {},
		domain.LessonRelationReference:      {},
		domain.LessonRelationPrerequisite:   {},
		domain.LessonRelationContinuation:   {},
		domain.LessonRelationSeeAlso:        {},
	}
)

// ReplaceExampleRelations reconciles all outgoing semantic links for one example.
type ReplaceExampleRelations struct {
	Examples  repository.LessonExampleRepository
	Relations repository.LessonExampleRelationRepository
	Tx        repository.TransactionManager
}

func (uc ReplaceExampleRelations) Handle(ctx context.Context, sourceExampleID string, relations []domain.LessonExampleRelation) error {
	sourceExampleID, err := normalizeID(sourceExampleID)
	if err != nil || uc.Examples == nil || uc.Relations == nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	normalized, err := normalizeRelations(sourceExampleID, relations)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	run := func(fn func(context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	return run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		if _, err := uc.Examples.Get(ctx, sourceExampleID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for _, relation := range normalized {
			if _, err := uc.Examples.Get(ctx, relation.TargetExampleID); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return uc.Relations.ReplaceBySourceExample(ctx, sourceExampleID, normalized)
	})
}

// ListExampleRelations returns outgoing example relations.
type ListExampleRelations struct {
	Examples  repository.LessonExampleRepository
	Relations repository.LessonExampleRelationRepository
}

func (uc ListExampleRelations) Handle(ctx context.Context, sourceExampleID string, activeOnly bool) ([]domain.LessonExampleRelation, error) {
	sourceExampleID, err := normalizeID(sourceExampleID)
	if err != nil || uc.Examples == nil || uc.Relations == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	example, err := uc.Examples.Get(ctx, sourceExampleID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if activeOnly && example.Status != domain.LessonExampleStatusActive {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return uc.Relations.ListBySourceExample(ctx, sourceExampleID, activeOnly)
}

// DeleteExampleRelation removes one semantic example relation.
type DeleteExampleRelation struct {
	Relations repository.LessonExampleRelationRepository
}

func (uc DeleteExampleRelation) Handle(ctx context.Context, relationID string) error {
	relationID, err := normalizeID(relationID)
	if err != nil || uc.Relations == nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return uc.Relations.Delete(ctx, relationID)
}

func normalizeRelations(sourceExampleID string, relations []domain.LessonExampleRelation) ([]domain.LessonExampleRelation, error) {
	result := make([]domain.LessonExampleRelation, 0, len(relations))
	sourceKeys := make(map[string]struct{}, len(relations))
	identities := make(map[string]struct{}, len(relations))
	for _, relation := range relations {
		if relation.ID == "" {
			relation.ID = uuid.NewString()
		} else {
			var err error
			relation.ID, err = normalizeID(relation.ID)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, domain.ErrValidation
			}
		}
		var err error
		relation.SourceKey, err = domain.NormalizeContentSourceKey(relation.SourceKey)
		if err != nil || relation.SourceKey == "" {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, exists := sourceKeys[relation.SourceKey]; exists {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate example relation source_key", domain.ErrConflict)
		}
		sourceKeys[relation.SourceKey] = struct{}{}
		relation.SourceExampleID = sourceExampleID
		relation.TargetExampleID, err = normalizeID(relation.TargetExampleID)
		if err != nil || relation.TargetExampleID == sourceExampleID {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		relation.Relation = strings.TrimSpace(relation.Relation)
		if _, ok := supportedRelations[relation.Relation]; !ok {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		identity := relation.TargetExampleID + "\x00" + relation.Relation
		if _, exists := identities[identity]; exists {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate semantic example relation", domain.ErrConflict)
		}
		identities[identity] = struct{}{}
		relation.Stacks, err = normalizeSlugs(relation.Stacks)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		relation.Concepts, err = normalizeSlugs(relation.Concepts)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		relation.PrimaryStack = strings.TrimSpace(relation.PrimaryStack)
		if !relationSlugPattern.MatchString(relation.PrimaryStack) || !contains(relation.Stacks, relation.PrimaryStack) {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		result = append(result, relation)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func normalizeSlugs(values []string) ([]string, error) {
	if len(values) == 0 {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	result := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
	for _, value := range values {
		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
		if len(value) > 128 || !relationSlugPattern.MatchString(value) {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, exists := seen[value]; exists {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		seen[value] = struct{}{}
		result = append(result, value)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func normalizeID(value string) (string, error) {
	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(value); err != nil {
		return "", domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return value, nil
}

func contains(values []string, target string) bool {
	for _, value := range values {
		if value == target {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
